resources.string: Allows GPS, fused and network location in automatic mode. Filters jumps, confirms recovery with 3 samples and suppresses parking jitter using fresh vehicle speed. GPS-only still excludes other sources. Next connection.

Excludes network and fused location. Drift protection remains controlled separately; turn it off to send unfiltered GPS positions. Reports no fix when GPS is lost or stale. Applies at the next connection.
